+class OptionError(Exception):

+@dataclass
+class Occurrence:
+    spec: ArgSpec
+    shown: str
+    value: Optional[str]
+

+@dataclass
+class Parsed:
+    occurrences: list[Occurrence] = field(default_factory=list)
+    paths: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+
+    def count(self, name: str) -> int:
+        return sum(o.spec.long == name for o in self.occurrences)
+
+    def has(self, name: str) -> bool:
+        return self.count(name) > 0
+
+    def last_value(self, *names: str) -> Optional[str]:
+        wanted = set(names)
+        for occurrence in reversed(self.occurrences):
+            if occurrence.spec.long in wanted and occurrence.value is not None:
+                return occurrence.value
+        return None
+
+    def last_flag(self, *names: str) -> Optional[str]:
+        wanted = set(names)
+        for occurrence in reversed(self.occurrences):

+                return occurrence.spec.long
+        return None

+def _choices_text(choices: tuple[str, ...]) -> str:
+    return "choices: " + ", ".join(choices)

+    suffix = f" ({_choices_text(choices)})" if choices else ""
+    return OptionError(f"Flag {shown} needs a value{suffix}")
+

+def parse_argv(argv: list[str]) -> Parsed:
+    parsed = Parsed()
+    parsing = True
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(argv):
+        token = argv[i]
+        i += 1
+        if not parsing:
+            parsed.paths.append(token)
+            continue
+        if token == "--":
+            parsing = False
+            continue
+        if token.startswith("--"):
+            body = token[2:]
+            before = body
+            after = None
+            if "=" in body:

+                    before, after = b, a
+            spec = BY_LONG.get(before)
+            if spec is None:
+                raise OptionError(f"Unknown argument --{before}")

+            if after is not None:
+                if spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                    raise OptionError(f"Flag {shown} cannot take a value")

+            elif spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                parsed.occurrences.append(Occurrence(spec, shown, None))
+            elif spec.takes == "necessary":
+                if i >= len(argv):
+                    raise _flag_needs_value(shown, spec.choices)
+                parsed.occurrences.append(Occurrence(spec, shown, argv[i]))
+                i += 1

+                    i += 1
+                else:
+                    value = spec.default
+                parsed.occurrences.append(Occurrence(spec, shown, value))

+                if before and after:

+                    spec = BY_SHORT.get(char)
+                    if spec is None:
+                        raise OptionError(f"Unknown argument -{char}")

+                    if spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                        raise OptionError(f"Flag {shown} cannot take a value")
+                    parsed.occurrences.append(Occurrence(spec, shown, after))
+                    continue
+            j = 0
+            while j < len(body):
+                char = body[j]
+                spec = BY_SHORT.get(char)
+                if spec is None:
+                    raise OptionError(f"Unknown argument -{char}")
+                shown = f"-{char}"
+                j += 1
+                if spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                    parsed.occurrences.append(Occurrence(spec, shown, None))
+                elif spec.takes == "necessary":
+                    if j < len(body):
+                        value = body[j:]
+                        j = len(body)
+                    elif i < len(argv):
+                        value = argv[i]
+                        i += 1
+                    else:
+                        raise _flag_needs_value(shown, spec.choices)
+                    parsed.occurrences.append(Occurrence(spec, shown, value))
+                    break
+                else:
+                    if j < len(body):
+                        value = body[j:]
+                        if spec.choices and value not in spec.choices:
+                            raise OptionError(f"Flag {shown} cannot take a value")
+                        j = len(body)
+                    elif i < len(argv) and spec.choices and argv[i] in spec.choices:
+                        value = argv[i]
+                        i += 1
+                    else:
+                        value = spec.default
+                    parsed.occurrences.append(Occurrence(spec, shown, value))
+                    break
+            continue
+        parsed.paths.append(token)
+    return parsed

+def _bad_argument(spec_name: str, value: str) -> OptionError:
+    spec = BY_LONG[spec_name]
+    suffix = f" ({_choices_text(spec.choices)})" if spec.takes == "necessary" and spec.choices else ""
+    escaped = value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"').replace("\n", "\\n")
+    return OptionError(f'Option {spec.label()} has no "{escaped}" setting{suffix}')
+
+
+def _parse_usize(value: str, source: str) -> int:
+    if not value or not value.isascii() or not value.isdigit():
+        raise OptionError(f'Value "{value}" not valid for option {source}: invalid digit found in string')
+    result = int(value, 10)
+    if result > (1 << 64) - 1:
+        raise OptionError(f'Value "{value}" not valid for option {source}: number too large to fit in target type')
+    return result
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Options:
+    mode: str = "lines"  # lines, grid, details, grid-details
+    tree: bool = False
+    recurse: bool = False
+    as_file: bool = False
+    level: Optional[int] = None
+    dot_mode: int = 0
+    sort: str = "name"
+    reverse: bool = False
+    dirs_first: bool = False
+    dirs_last: bool = False
+    only_dirs: bool = False
+    only_files: bool = False
+    no_symlinks: bool = False
+    show_symlinks: bool = False
+    ignore_patterns: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+    across: bool = False
+    width: Optional[int] = None
+    quote: bool = True
+    classify: str = "never"
+    absolute: str = "off"
+    deref: bool = False
+    follow_links: bool = False
+    hyperlink: bool = False
+    header: bool = False
+    permissions: bool = True
+    filesize: bool = True
+    time_fields: list[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: ["modified"])
+    time_style: str = "default"
+    size_style: str = "decimal"
+    file_flags: bool = False
+    stdin: bool = False
+
+
+def deduce_options(parsed: Parsed) -> Options:
+    opts = Options()
+
+    width_value = parsed.last_value("width")
+    if width_value is not None:
+        width = _parse_usize(width_value, BY_LONG["width"].label())
+        opts.width = width if width >= 1 else None
+    elif "COLUMNS" in os.environ:
+        value = os.environ["COLUMNS"]
+        if not value.isdigit():
+            raise OptionError(
+                f'Value "{value}" not valid for environment variable COLUMNS: invalid digit found in string'
+            )
+        opts.width = int(value)
+
+    is_tty = opts.width is not None or sys.stdout.isatty()
+    view_flag = parsed.last_flag("long", "oneline", "grid", "tree")
+    if view_flag is None:
+        opts.mode = "grid" if is_tty else "lines"
+    elif view_flag == "long" or (view_flag == "tree" and parsed.has("long")) or (
+        view_flag == "grid" and parsed.has("long")
+    ):
+        grid_tree_flag = parsed.last_flag("grid", "tree")
+        opts.mode = "grid-details" if grid_tree_flag == "grid" else "details"
+    elif view_flag == "tree":
+        opts.mode = "details"
+    elif view_flag == "oneline":
+        opts.mode = "lines"
+    else:
+        opts.mode = "grid"
+
+    requested_tree = parsed.has("tree")
+    opts.tree = requested_tree and opts.mode == "details"
+    opts.recurse = opts.tree or parsed.has("recurse")
+    opts.as_file = (parsed.has("treat-dirs-as-files") or parsed.has("list-dirs")) and not opts.recurse
+
+    level_value = parsed.last_value("level")
+    if level_value is not None:
+        opts.level = _parse_usize(level_value, BY_LONG["level"].label())
+
+    all_count = parsed.count("all")
+    if all_count >= 2 and requested_tree:

+def _path_name(path: str) -> str:
+    normalized = ntpath.normpath(path)
+    name = ntpath.basename(normalized)
+    if name:
+        return name
+    if path in (".", ".."):

+    drive, tail = ntpath.splitdrive(normalized)

+@dataclass
+class FileInfo:
+    path: str
+    name: str
+    parented: bool = False
+    is_all_all: bool = False
+    _lstat: Optional[os.stat_result] = None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def argument(cls, path: str) -> "FileInfo":
+        return cls(path=path, name=_path_name(path))
+
+    @classmethod
+    def child(cls, directory: str, name: str, st: Optional[os.stat_result] = None) -> "FileInfo":
+        return cls(path=ntpath.join(directory, name), name=name, parented=True, _lstat=st)

+    def lstat(self) -> os.stat_result:
+        if self._lstat is None:
+            self._lstat = os.lstat(self.path)
+        return self._lstat
+
+    def followed_stat(self) -> os.stat_result:
+        return os.stat(self.path)
+
+    def attrs(self) -> int:
+        st = self.lstat()
+        attrs = getattr(st, "st_file_attributes", 0)
+        if attrs:
+            return int(attrs)
+        result = 0
+        if _stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode):
+            result |= FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY
+        elif _stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
+            result |= FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE
+        if not os.access(self.path, os.W_OK):
+            result |= FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY
+        if self.is_link():
+            result |= FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT
+        return result
+
+    def is_link(self) -> bool:
+        return _stat.S_ISLNK(self.lstat().st_mode) or bool(self.attrs() & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT and os.path.islink(self.path))
+
+    def is_dir(self) -> bool:
+        return _stat.S_ISDIR(self.lstat().st_mode) and not self.is_link()
+
+    def is_file(self) -> bool:
+        return _stat.S_ISREG(self.lstat().st_mode) and not self.is_link()
+
+    def points_to_dir(self) -> bool:
+        if self.is_dir():
+            return True
+        if self.is_link():
+            try:
+                return os.path.isdir(self.path)
+            except OSError:
+                return False
+        return False
+
+    def length(self) -> int:
+        return int(self.lstat().st_size)
+
+    def extension(self) -> Optional[str]:
+        pos = self.name.rfind(".")
+        return None if pos < 0 else self.name[pos + 1 :].lower()
+
+    def time_ns(self, which: str, deref: bool = False) -> Optional[int]:
+        try:
+            st = self.followed_stat() if deref and self.is_link() else self.lstat()
+        except OSError:
+            return None
+        if which in ("modified", "changed"):
+            return int(st.st_mtime_ns)
+        if which == "accessed":
+            return int(st.st_atime_ns)
+        birth_ns = getattr(st, "st_birthtime_ns", None)
+        return int(birth_ns if birth_ns is not None else st.st_ctime_ns)

+_NATURAL_PARTS = re.compile(r"(\d+)")

+def _natural_chunks(value: str, insensitive: bool) -> list[tuple[int, object, object]]:
+    if insensitive:
+        value = value.lower()
+    chunks: list[tuple[int, object, object]] = []
+    for part in _NATURAL_PARTS.split(value):
+        if not part:
+            continue
+        if part.isdigit():
+            significant = part.lstrip("0") or "0"
+            chunks.append((0, len(significant), significant))
+        else:
+            chunks.append((1, part, ""))
+    return chunks

+def _compare_values(a, b) -> int:
+    return (a > b) - (a < b)
+
+
+def _natural_compare(a: str, b: str, insensitive: bool) -> int:
+    ac = _natural_chunks(a, insensitive)
+    bc = _natural_chunks(b, insensitive)
+    for left, right in zip(ac, bc):
+        result = _compare_values(left, right)
+        if result:
+            return result
+    return _compare_values(len(ac), len(bc))
+

+def compare_files(a: FileInfo, b: FileInfo, opts: Options) -> int:
+    field_name = opts.sort
+    if field_name == "none":
+        return 0
+    if field_name in ("name", "Name", ".name", ".Name"):
+        an = a.name[1:] if field_name.startswith(".") and a.name.startswith(".") else a.name
+        bn = b.name[1:] if field_name.startswith(".") and b.name.startswith(".") else b.name
+        return _natural_compare(an, bn, field_name in ("name", ".name"))
+    if field_name in ("extension", "Extension"):
+        ae, be = a.extension(), b.extension()
+        if ae is None or be is None:
+            result = _compare_values(ae is not None, be is not None)
+        else:
+            result = _compare_values(ae, be)
+        if result:
+            return result
+        return _natural_compare(a.name, b.name, field_name == "extension")
+    if field_name == "size":
+        return _compare_values(a.length(), b.length())
+    if field_name in ("modified", "changed", "accessed", "created", "age"):
+        left = a.time_ns(field_name if field_name != "age" else "modified", opts.deref)
+        right = b.time_ns(field_name if field_name != "age" else "modified", opts.deref)
+        lk = (-1 if left is None else left)
+        rk = (-1 if right is None else right)
+        result = _compare_values(lk, rk)
+        return -result if field_name == "age" else result
+    if field_name == "type":
+        def rank(f: FileInfo) -> int:
+            if f.is_dir(): return 0
+            if f.is_file(): return 1
+            return 7
+        result = _compare_values(rank(a), rank(b))
+        return result or _natural_compare(a.name, b.name, False)
+    return 0
+

+def sort_files(files: list[FileInfo], opts: Options) -> list[FileInfo]:
+    files.sort(key=functools.cmp_to_key(lambda a, b: compare_files(a, b, opts)))
+    if opts.reverse:
+        files.reverse()
+    if opts.dirs_first:
+        files.sort(key=lambda f: not f.points_to_dir())
+    elif opts.dirs_last:
+        files.sort(key=lambda f: f.points_to_dir())
+    return files

+def _ignored(name: str, patterns: Iterable[str]) -> bool:

+def filter_children(files: list[FileInfo], opts: Options, is_recurse: bool) -> list[FileInfo]:
+    result = [f for f in files if not _ignored(f.name, opts.ignore_patterns)]
+    filtered: list[FileInfo] = []
+    for f in result:
+        keep = True
+        if opts.only_dirs and not opts.only_files:
+            keep = f.is_dir() or (opts.show_symlinks and f.points_to_dir())
+        elif opts.only_files and not opts.only_dirs:
+            if is_recurse:
+                keep = True
+            elif opts.show_symlinks:
+                keep = f.is_file() or (f.is_link() and not f.points_to_dir())
+            else:
+                keep = f.is_file()
+        elif opts.no_symlinks and not opts.show_symlinks:
+            keep = not f.is_link()
+        if keep:
+            filtered.append(f)

+def _escape_control(text: str) -> str:
+    pieces = []
+    mapping = {"\t": "\\t", "\r": "\\r", "\n": "\\n", "\0": "\\0", "\\": "\\\\", "'": "\\'", '"': '\\"'}
+    for char in text:
+        code = ord(char)
+        if code >= 0x20 and code != 0x7F:
+            pieces.append(char)
+        elif char in mapping:
+            pieces.append(mapping[char])
+        else:
+            pieces.append(f"\\u{{{code:x}}}")
+    return "".join(pieces)
+

+def escape_name(text: str, quote: bool) -> str:
+    escaped = _escape_control(text)
+    needs_quotes = " " in text or "'" in text
+    if quote and needs_quotes:
+        mark = '"' if "'" in text else "'"
+        return mark + escaped + mark
+    return escaped

+def _normal_display_path(path: str) -> str:
+    return ntpath.normpath(path)

+def display_base_name(file: FileInfo, opts: Options) -> str:
+    if opts.absolute == "on":
+        raw = ntpath.abspath(file.path)
+        return escape_name(_normal_display_path(raw), opts.quote)
+    if opts.absolute == "follow":
+        try:
+            raw = os.path.realpath(file.path)
+        except OSError:
+            raw = ntpath.abspath(file.path)
+        return escape_name(_normal_display_path(raw), opts.quote)
+    prefix = ""
+    if not file.parented:
+        parent = ntpath.dirname(_normal_display_path(file.path))
+        if parent:
+            prefix = escape_name(parent, opts.quote) + "\\"
+    return prefix + escape_name(file.name, opts.quote)

+def _classify(file: FileInfo, opts: Options) -> str:
+    if opts.classify != "always":
+        return ""
+    if file.is_dir():

+    if file.is_link():
+        return "@"
+    return ""

+def _link_target_text(file: FileInfo, opts: Options) -> Optional[str]:
+    if not file.is_link() or opts.deref:
+        return None
+    try:
+        target_path = os.readlink(file.path)
+    except OSError:
+        return None
+    if target_path.startswith("\\\\?\\"):
+        target_path = target_path[4:]
+    target_exists = os.path.exists(file.path)
+    if not target_exists:
+        return escape_name(target_path, opts.quote)
+    parent = ntpath.dirname(_normal_display_path(target_path))
+    name = _path_name(target_path)
+    shown = (escape_name(parent, opts.quote) + "\\" if parent else "") + escape_name(name, opts.quote)
+    try:
+        target_info = FileInfo(target_path if ntpath.isabs(target_path) else ntpath.join(ntpath.dirname(file.path), target_path), name)
+        shown += _classify(target_info, opts)
+    except OSError:
+        pass
+    return shown

+def display_name(file: FileInfo, opts: Options, show_link: bool = True) -> str:
+    result = display_base_name(file, opts)
+    target = _link_target_text(file, opts) if show_link else None
+    if target is not None:
+        result += " -> " + target
+    else:
+        result += _classify(file, opts)
+    if opts.hyperlink:
+        try:
+            absolute = os.path.realpath(file.path)
+            uri_path = absolute.replace(" ", "%20")
+            result = f"\x1b]8;;file://{uri_path}\x1b\\{result}\x1b]8;;\x1b\\"
+        except OSError:
+            pass
+    return result

+def display_width(text: str) -> int:
+    width = 0
+    in_escape = False
+    for char in text:
+        if char == "\x1b":
+            in_escape = True
+            continue
+        if in_escape:
+            if char == "\\":
+                in_escape = False
+            continue
+        if unicodedata.combining(char):
+            continue
+        width += 2 if unicodedata.east_asian_width(char) in ("W", "F") else 1

+def size_text(file: FileInfo, opts: Options) -> str:
+    if file.is_dir():
+        return "-"
+    size = file.length()
+    if opts.size_style == "bytes":
+        return f"{size:,}"
+    if opts.size_style == "binary":
+        base, symbols = 1024.0, ("", "Ki", "Mi", "Gi", "Ti", "Pi", "Ei")
+    else:
+        base, symbols = 1000.0, ("", "k", "M", "G", "T", "P", "E")
+    if size < base:
+        return f"{size:,}"
+    power = min(int(math.log(size, base)), len(symbols) - 1)
+    number = size / (base ** power)
+    shown = f"{number:.1f}" if number < 10 else f"{_round_rust(number):,}"
+    return shown + symbols[power]

+def _current_offset() -> _datetime.timedelta:
+    return _datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().utcoffset() or _datetime.timedelta(0)

+def _datetime_for_ns(ns: int) -> _datetime.datetime:
+    seconds, nanos = divmod(ns, 1_000_000_000)
+    base = _datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(seconds, _datetime.timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)
+    return base + _current_offset(), nanos

+MONTHS = ("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec")

+def _relative_time(seconds: int) -> str:
+    if seconds < 1: return "now"
+    units = ((365 * 86400, "year"), (30 * 86400, "month"), (7 * 86400, "week"), (86400, "day"), (3600, "hour"), (60, "minute"), (1, "second"))
+    for scale, label in units:
+        if seconds >= scale:
+            value = seconds // scale
+            return f"{value} {label}{'' if value == 1 else 's'}"
+    return "now"

+def time_text(file: FileInfo, which: str, opts: Options) -> str:
+    ns = file.time_ns(which, opts.deref)
+    if ns is None:
+        return "-"
+    value, nanos = _datetime_for_ns(ns)
+    style = opts.time_style
+    current_year = _datetime.datetime.now().year
+    if style == "default":
+        if value.year == current_year:
+            return f"{value.day:2} {MONTHS[value.month - 1]} {value:%H:%M}"
+        return f"{value.day:2} {MONTHS[value.month - 1]}  {value.year:04d}"
+    if style == "iso":
+        return value.strftime("%m-%d %H:%M") if value.year == current_year else value.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
+    if style == "long-iso":
+        return value.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
+    if style == "full-iso":
+        offset_seconds = int(_current_offset().total_seconds())
+        sign = "+" if offset_seconds >= 0 else "-"
+        offset_seconds = abs(offset_seconds)
+        zone = f"{sign}{offset_seconds // 3600:02d}{offset_seconds % 3600 // 60:02d}"
+        return value.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") + f".{nanos:09d} {zone}"
+    if style == "relative":
+        age = max(0, int(_datetime.datetime.now().timestamp() - ns / 1_000_000_000))
+        return _relative_time(age)
+    if style.startswith("+"):
+        formats = style[1:].splitlines()
+        chosen = formats[1] if len(formats) > 1 and value.year == current_year else formats[0]
+        return value.strftime(chosen)
+    return "-"

+    output = []

+    spec = BY_LONG[spec_name]
+    suffix = f" ({_choices_text(spec.choices)})" if spec.takes == "necessary" and spec.choices else ""
+    escaped = value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"').replace("\n", "\\n")
+    return OptionError(f'Option {spec.label()} has no "{escaped}" setting{suffix}')

+def _parse_usize(value: str, source: str) -> int:
+    if not value or not value.isascii() or not value.isdigit():
+        raise OptionError(f'Value "{value}" not valid for option {source}: invalid digit found in string')
+    result = int(value, 10)
+    if result > (1 << 64) - 1:
+        raise OptionError(f'Value "{value}" not valid for option {source}: number too large to fit in target type')
+    return result

+    elif view_flag == "long" or (view_flag == "tree" and parsed.has("long")) or (

+    elif view_flag == "tree":

+    level_value = parsed.last_value("level")

+    opts.dot_mode = 2 if all_count >= 2 else (1 if all_count or parsed.has("almost-all") else 0)

+    sort_value = parsed.last_value("sort")
+    aliases = {

+        "size": "size", "filesize": "size", "ext": "extension", "extension": "extension",

+        "acc": "accessed", "accessed": "accessed", "cr": "created", "created": "created",

+    if sort_value is not None:

+    opts.reverse = parsed.has("reverse")

+    opts.dirs_last = parsed.has("group-directories-last")
+    opts.only_dirs = parsed.has("only-dirs")

+    opts.across = parsed.has("across")

+    opts.deref = parsed.has("dereference")
+    opts.follow_links = parsed.has("follow-symlinks")
+    opts.hyperlink = parsed.has("hyperlink")

+    classify = parsed.last_value("classify")

+    absolute = parsed.last_value("absolute")

+        mapping = {"on": "on", "yes": "on", "follow": "follow", "off": "off", "no": "off"}

+    opts.header = parsed.has("header")

+    opts.filesize = not parsed.has("no-filesize")

+FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN = 0x00000002
+FILE_ATTRIBUTE_SYSTEM = 0x00000004
+FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY = 0x00000010
+FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE = 0x00000020
+FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT = 0x00000400

+def _path_name(path: str) -> str:
+    normalized = ntpath.normpath(path)
+    name = ntpath.basename(normalized)
+    if name:
+        return name
+    if path in (".", ".."):
+        return path
+    drive, tail = ntpath.splitdrive(normalized)
+    return tail or drive or path

+@dataclass
+class FileInfo:
+    path: str
+    name: str
+    parented: bool = False
+    is_all_all: bool = False
+    _lstat: Optional[os.stat_result] = None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def argument(cls, path: str) -> "FileInfo":
+        return cls(path=path, name=_path_name(path))
+
+    @classmethod
+    def child(cls, directory: str, name: str, st: Optional[os.stat_result] = None) -> "FileInfo":
+        return cls(path=ntpath.join(directory, name), name=name, parented=True, _lstat=st)
+
+    def lstat(self) -> os.stat_result:
+        if self._lstat is None:
+            self._lstat = os.lstat(self.path)
+        return self._lstat
+
+    def followed_stat(self) -> os.stat_result:
+        return os.stat(self.path)
+
+    def attrs(self) -> int:
+        st = self.lstat()
+        attrs = getattr(st, "st_file_attributes", 0)
+        if attrs:
+            return int(attrs)
+        result = 0
+        if _stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode):
+            result |= FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY
+        elif _stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
+            result |= FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE
+        if not os.access(self.path, os.W_OK):
+            result |= FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY
+        if self.is_link():
+            result |= FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT
+        return result
+
+    def is_link(self) -> bool:
+        return _stat.S_ISLNK(self.lstat().st_mode) or bool(self.attrs() & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT and os.path.islink(self.path))
+
+    def is_dir(self) -> bool:
+        return _stat.S_ISDIR(self.lstat().st_mode) and not self.is_link()
+
+    def is_file(self) -> bool:
+        return _stat.S_ISREG(self.lstat().st_mode) and not self.is_link()
+
+    def points_to_dir(self) -> bool:
+        if self.is_dir():
+            return True
+        if self.is_link():
+            try:
+                return os.path.isdir(self.path)
+            except OSError:
+                return False
+        return False
+
+    def length(self) -> int:
+        return int(self.lstat().st_size)
+
+    def extension(self) -> Optional[str]:
+        pos = self.name.rfind(".")
+        return None if pos < 0 else self.name[pos + 1 :].lower()
+
+    def time_ns(self, which: str, deref: bool = False) -> Optional[int]:
+        try:
+            st = self.followed_stat() if deref and self.is_link() else self.lstat()
+        except OSError:
+            return None
+        if which in ("modified", "changed"):
+            return int(st.st_mtime_ns)
+        if which == "accessed":
+            return int(st.st_atime_ns)
+        birth_ns = getattr(st, "st_birthtime_ns", None)
+        return int(birth_ns if birth_ns is not None else st.st_ctime_ns)

+_NATURAL_PARTS = re.compile(r"(\d+)")
+
+
+def _natural_chunks(value: str, insensitive: bool) -> list[tuple[int, object, object]]:
+    if insensitive:
+        value = value.lower()
+    chunks: list[tuple[int, object, object]] = []
+    for part in _NATURAL_PARTS.split(value):
+        if not part:
+            continue
+        if part.isdigit():
+            significant = part.lstrip("0") or "0"
+            chunks.append((0, len(significant), significant))
+        else:
+            chunks.append((1, part, ""))
+    return chunks
+

+def _compare_values(a, b) -> int:
+    return (a > b) - (a < b)
+
+
+def _natural_compare(a: str, b: str, insensitive: bool) -> int:
+    ac = _natural_chunks(a, insensitive)
+    bc = _natural_chunks(b, insensitive)
+    for left, right in zip(ac, bc):
+        result = _compare_values(left, right)
+        if result:
+            return result
+    return _compare_values(len(ac), len(bc))
+

+def compare_files(a: FileInfo, b: FileInfo, opts: Options) -> int:
+    field_name = opts.sort
+    if field_name == "none":
+        return 0
+    if field_name in ("name", "Name", ".name", ".Name"):
+        an = a.name[1:] if field_name.startswith(".") and a.name.startswith(".") else a.name
+        bn = b.name[1:] if field_name.startswith(".") and b.name.startswith(".") else b.name
+        return _natural_compare(an, bn, field_name in ("name", ".name"))
+    if field_name in ("extension", "Extension"):
+        ae, be = a.extension(), b.extension()
+        if ae is None or be is None:
+            result = _compare_values(ae is not None, be is not None)
+        else:
+            result = _compare_values(ae, be)
+        if result:
+            return result
+        return _natural_compare(a.name, b.name, field_name == "extension")
+    if field_name == "size":
+        return _compare_values(a.length(), b.length())
+    if field_name in ("modified", "changed", "accessed", "created", "age"):
+        left = a.time_ns(field_name if field_name != "age" else "modified", opts.deref)
+        right = b.time_ns(field_name if field_name != "age" else "modified", opts.deref)
+        lk = (-1 if left is None else left)
+        rk = (-1 if right is None else right)
+        result = _compare_values(lk, rk)
+        return -result if field_name == "age" else result
+    if field_name == "type":
+        def rank(f: FileInfo) -> int:
+            if f.is_dir(): return 0
+            if f.is_file(): return 1
+            return 7
+        result = _compare_values(rank(a), rank(b))
+        return result or _natural_compare(a.name, b.name, False)
+    return 0
+

+def sort_files(files: list[FileInfo], opts: Options) -> list[FileInfo]:
+    files.sort(key=functools.cmp_to_key(lambda a, b: compare_files(a, b, opts)))
+    if opts.reverse:
+        files.reverse()
+    if opts.dirs_first:
+        files.sort(key=lambda f: not f.points_to_dir())
+    elif opts.dirs_last:
+        files.sort(key=lambda f: f.points_to_dir())
+    return files

+def _ignored(name: str, patterns: Iterable[str]) -> bool:
+    return any(fnmatch.fnmatchcase(name, pattern) for pattern in patterns)

+def filter_children(files: list[FileInfo], opts: Options, is_recurse: bool) -> list[FileInfo]:
+    result = [f for f in files if not _ignored(f.name, opts.ignore_patterns)]
+    filtered: list[FileInfo] = []
+    for f in result:
+        keep = True
+        if opts.only_dirs and not opts.only_files:
+            keep = f.is_dir() or (opts.show_symlinks and f.points_to_dir())
+        elif opts.only_files and not opts.only_dirs:
+            if is_recurse:
+                keep = True
+            elif opts.show_symlinks:
+                keep = f.is_file() or (f.is_link() and not f.points_to_dir())
+            else:
+                keep = f.is_file()
+        elif opts.no_symlinks and not opts.show_symlinks:
+            keep = not f.is_link()
+        if keep:
+            filtered.append(f)
+    return filtered

+def read_children(directory: FileInfo, opts: Options) -> list[FileInfo]:
+    children: list[FileInfo] = []
+    if opts.dot_mode == 2:
+        current = FileInfo(directory.path, ".", True, True)
+        parent = FileInfo(ntpath.join(directory.path, ".."), "..", True, True)
+        children.extend((current, parent))
+    with os.scandir(directory.path) as entries:
+        for entry in entries:
+            name = entry.name
+            try:
+                st = entry.stat(follow_symlinks=False)
+            except OSError:
+                st = None
+            child = FileInfo.child(directory.path, name, st)
+            if opts.dot_mode == 0:
+                if name.startswith(".") or name.startswith("_"):
+                    continue
+                try:
+                    if child.attrs() & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN:
+                        continue
+                except OSError:
+                    pass
+            children.append(child)
+    return children

+def _escape_control(text: str) -> str:
+    pieces = []
+    mapping = {"\t": "\\t", "\r": "\\r", "\n": "\\n", "\0": "\\0", "\\": "\\\\", "'": "\\'", '"': '\\"'}
+    for char in text:
+        code = ord(char)
+        if code >= 0x20 and code != 0x7F:
+            pieces.append(char)
+        elif char in mapping:
+            pieces.append(mapping[char])
+        else:
+            pieces.append(f"\\u{{{code:x}}}")
+    return "".join(pieces)
+

+def escape_name(text: str, quote: bool) -> str:
+    escaped = _escape_control(text)
+    needs_quotes = " " in text or "'" in text
+    if quote and needs_quotes:
+        mark = '"' if "'" in text else "'"
+        return mark + escaped + mark
+    return escaped

+def display_base_name(file: FileInfo, opts: Options) -> str:
+    if opts.absolute == "on":
+        raw = ntpath.abspath(file.path)
+        return escape_name(_normal_display_path(raw), opts.quote)
+    if opts.absolute == "follow":
+        try:
+            raw = os.path.realpath(file.path)
+        except OSError:
+            raw = ntpath.abspath(file.path)
+        return escape_name(_normal_display_path(raw), opts.quote)
+    prefix = ""
+    if not file.parented:
+        parent = ntpath.dirname(_normal_display_path(file.path))
+        if parent:
+            prefix = escape_name(parent, opts.quote) + "\\"
+    return prefix + escape_name(file.name, opts.quote)

+def _classify(file: FileInfo, opts: Options) -> str:
+    if opts.classify != "always":
+        return ""
+    if file.is_dir():
+        return "/"
+    if file.is_link():
+        return "@"
+    return ""

+def _link_target_text(file: FileInfo, opts: Options) -> Optional[str]:
+    if not file.is_link() or opts.deref:
+        return None
+    try:
+        target_path = os.readlink(file.path)
+    except OSError:
+        return None
+    if target_path.startswith("\\\\?\\"):
+        target_path = target_path[4:]
+    target_exists = os.path.exists(file.path)
+    if not target_exists:
+        return escape_name(target_path, opts.quote)
+    parent = ntpath.dirname(_normal_display_path(target_path))
+    name = _path_name(target_path)
+    shown = (escape_name(parent, opts.quote) + "\\" if parent else "") + escape_name(name, opts.quote)
+    try:
+        target_info = FileInfo(target_path if ntpath.isabs(target_path) else ntpath.join(ntpath.dirname(file.path), target_path), name)
+        shown += _classify(target_info, opts)
+    except OSError:
+        pass
+    return shown

+def display_name(file: FileInfo, opts: Options, show_link: bool = True) -> str:
+    result = display_base_name(file, opts)
+    target = _link_target_text(file, opts) if show_link else None
+    if target is not None:
+        result += " -> " + target
+    else:
+        result += _classify(file, opts)
+    if opts.hyperlink:
+        try:
+            absolute = os.path.realpath(file.path)
+            uri_path = absolute.replace(" ", "%20")
+            result = f"\x1b]8;;file://{uri_path}\x1b\\{result}\x1b]8;;\x1b\\"
+        except OSError:
+            pass
+    return result

+def display_width(text: str) -> int:
+    width = 0
+    in_escape = False
+    for char in text:
+        if char == "\x1b":
+            in_escape = True
+            continue
+        if in_escape:
+            if char == "\\":
+                in_escape = False
+            continue
+        if unicodedata.combining(char):

+    return kind + ("a" if attrs & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE else "-") + ("r" if attrs & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY else "-") + ("h" if attrs & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN else "-") + ("s" if attrs & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_SYSTEM else "-")

+def size_text(file: FileInfo, opts: Options) -> str:
+    if file.is_dir():
+        return "-"
+    size = file.length()
+    if opts.size_style == "bytes":
+        return f"{size:,}"
+    if opts.size_style == "binary":
+        base, symbols = 1024.0, ("", "Ki", "Mi", "Gi", "Ti", "Pi", "Ei")
+    else:
+        base, symbols = 1000.0, ("", "k", "M", "G", "T", "P", "E")
+    if size < base:
+        return f"{size:,}"
+    power = min(int(math.log(size, base)), len(symbols) - 1)
+    number = size / (base ** power)
+    shown = f"{number:.1f}" if number < 10 else f"{_round_rust(number):,}"
+    return shown + symbols[power]

+def _relative_time(seconds: int) -> str:
+    if seconds < 1: return "now"
+    units = ((365 * 86400, "year"), (30 * 86400, "month"), (7 * 86400, "week"), (86400, "day"), (3600, "hour"), (60, "minute"), (1, "second"))
+    for scale, label in units:
+        if seconds >= scale:

+def parse_argv(argv: list[str]) -> Parsed:
+    parsed = Parsed()
+    parsing = True
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(argv):
+        token = argv[i]
+        i += 1
+        if not parsing:
+            parsed.paths.append(token)
+            continue
+        if token == "--":
+            parsing = False
+            continue
+        if token.startswith("--"):
+            body = token[2:]
+            before = body
+            after = None
+            if "=" in body:
+                b, a = body.split("=", 1)
+                if b and a:
+                    before, after = b, a
+            spec = BY_LONG.get(before)
+            if spec is None:
+                raise OptionError(f"Unknown argument --{before}")
+            shown = f"--{spec.long}"
+            if after is not None:
+                if spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                    raise OptionError(f"Flag {shown} cannot take a value")
+                parsed.occurrences.append(Occurrence(spec, shown, after))
+            elif spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                parsed.occurrences.append(Occurrence(spec, shown, None))
+            elif spec.takes == "necessary":
+                if i >= len(argv):
+                    raise _flag_needs_value(shown, spec.choices)
+                parsed.occurrences.append(Occurrence(spec, shown, argv[i]))
+                i += 1
+            else:
+                if i < len(argv) and spec.choices and argv[i] in spec.choices:
+                    value = argv[i]
+                    i += 1
+                else:
+                    value = spec.default
+                parsed.occurrences.append(Occurrence(spec, shown, value))
+            continue
+        if token.startswith("-") and token != "-":
+            body = token[1:]
+            if "=" in body:
+                before, after = body.split("=", 1)
+                if before and after:
+                    for char in before[:-1]:
+                        spec = BY_SHORT.get(char)
+                        if spec is None:
+                            raise OptionError(f"Unknown argument -{char}")
+                        shown = f"-{char}"
+                        if spec.takes == "necessary":
+                            raise _flag_needs_value(shown, spec.choices)
+                        value = spec.default if spec.takes == "optional" else None
+                        parsed.occurrences.append(Occurrence(spec, shown, value))
+                    char = before[-1]
+                    spec = BY_SHORT.get(char)
+                    if spec is None:
+                        raise OptionError(f"Unknown argument -{char}")
+                    shown = f"-{char}"
+                    if spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                        raise OptionError(f"Flag {shown} cannot take a value")
+                    parsed.occurrences.append(Occurrence(spec, shown, after))
+                    continue
+            j = 0
+            while j < len(body):
+                char = body[j]
+                spec = BY_SHORT.get(char)
+                if spec is None:
+                    raise OptionError(f"Unknown argument -{char}")
+                shown = f"-{char}"
+                j += 1
+                if spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                    parsed.occurrences.append(Occurrence(spec, shown, None))
+                elif spec.takes == "necessary":
+                    if j < len(body):
+                        value = body[j:]
+                        j = len(body)
+                    elif i < len(argv):
+                        value = argv[i]
+                        i += 1
+                    else:
+                        raise _flag_needs_value(shown, spec.choices)
+                    parsed.occurrences.append(Occurrence(spec, shown, value))
+                    break
+                else:
+                    if j < len(body):
+                        value = body[j:]
+                        if spec.choices and value not in spec.choices:
+                            raise OptionError(f"Flag {shown} cannot take a value")
+                        j = len(body)
+                    elif i < len(argv) and spec.choices and argv[i] in spec.choices:
+                        value = argv[i]
+                        i += 1
+                    else:
+                        value = spec.default
+                    parsed.occurrences.append(Occurrence(spec, shown, value))
+                    break
+            continue
+        parsed.paths.append(token)
+    return parsed
+

+def _bad_argument(spec_name: str, value: str) -> OptionError:
+    spec = BY_LONG[spec_name]
+    suffix = f" ({_choices_text(spec.choices)})" if spec.takes == "necessary" and spec.choices else ""
+    escaped = value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"').replace("\n", "\\n")
+    return OptionError(f'Option {spec.label()} has no "{escaped}" setting{suffix}')

+def _parse_usize(value: str, source: str) -> int:
+    if not value or not value.isascii() or not value.isdigit():
+        raise OptionError(f'Value "{value}" not valid for option {source}: invalid digit found in string')
+    result = int(value, 10)
+    if result > (1 << 64) - 1:
+        raise OptionError(f'Value "{value}" not valid for option {source}: number too large to fit in target type')
+    return result

+def deduce_options(parsed: Parsed) -> Options:
+    opts = Options()
+
+    width_value = parsed.last_value("width")
+    if width_value is not None:
+        width = _parse_usize(width_value, BY_LONG["width"].label())
+        opts.width = width if width >= 1 else None
+    elif "COLUMNS" in os.environ:
+        value = os.environ["COLUMNS"]
+        if not value.isdigit():
+            raise OptionError(
+                f'Value "{value}" not valid for environment variable COLUMNS: invalid digit found in string'
+            )
+        opts.width = int(value)
+
+    is_tty = opts.width is not None or sys.stdout.isatty()
+    view_flag = parsed.last_flag("long", "oneline", "grid", "tree")
+    if view_flag is None:
+        opts.mode = "grid" if is_tty else "lines"
+    elif view_flag == "long" or (view_flag == "tree" and parsed.has("long")) or (
+        view_flag == "grid" and parsed.has("long")
+    ):
+        grid_tree_flag = parsed.last_flag("grid", "tree")
+        opts.mode = "grid-details" if grid_tree_flag == "grid" else "details"
+    elif view_flag == "tree":
+        opts.mode = "details"
+    elif view_flag == "oneline":
+        opts.mode = "lines"
+    else:
+        opts.mode = "grid"
+
+    requested_tree = parsed.has("tree")
+    opts.tree = requested_tree and opts.mode == "details"
+    opts.recurse = opts.tree or parsed.has("recurse")
+    opts.as_file = (parsed.has("treat-dirs-as-files") or parsed.has("list-dirs")) and not opts.recurse
+
+    level_value = parsed.last_value("level")
+    if level_value is not None:
+        opts.level = _parse_usize(level_value, BY_LONG["level"].label())
+
+    all_count = parsed.count("all")
+    if all_count >= 2 and requested_tree:
+        raise OptionError("Option --tree is useless given --all --all")
+    opts.dot_mode = 2 if all_count >= 2 else (1 if all_count or parsed.has("almost-all") else 0)
+
+    sort_value = parsed.last_value("sort")
+    aliases = {
+        "name": "name", "filename": "name", "Name": "Name", "Filename": "Name",
+        ".name": ".name", ".filename": ".name", ".Name": ".Name", ".Filename": ".Name",
+        "size": "size", "filesize": "size", "ext": "extension", "extension": "extension",
+        "Ext": "Extension", "Extension": "Extension", "date": "modified", "time": "modified",
+        "mod": "modified", "modified": "modified", "new": "modified", "newest": "modified",
+        "age": "age", "old": "age", "oldest": "age", "ch": "changed", "changed": "changed",
+        "acc": "accessed", "accessed": "accessed", "cr": "created", "created": "created",
+        "type": "type", "none": "none",
+    }
+    if sort_value is not None:
+        if sort_value not in aliases:
+            raise _bad_argument("sort", sort_value)
+        opts.sort = aliases[sort_value]
+
+    opts.reverse = parsed.has("reverse")
+    opts.dirs_first = parsed.has("group-directories-first")
+    opts.dirs_last = parsed.has("group-directories-last")
+    opts.only_dirs = parsed.has("only-dirs")
+    opts.only_files = parsed.has("only-files")
+    opts.no_symlinks = parsed.has("no-symlinks")
+    opts.show_symlinks = parsed.has("show-symlinks")
+    ignore = parsed.last_value("ignore-glob")
+    opts.ignore_patterns = [] if ignore is None else ignore.split("|")
+    opts.across = parsed.has("across")
+    opts.quote = not parsed.has("no-quotes")
+    opts.deref = parsed.has("dereference")
+    opts.follow_links = parsed.has("follow-symlinks")
+    opts.hyperlink = parsed.has("hyperlink")
+
+    classify = parsed.last_value("classify")
+    if classify is not None:
+        if classify not in ("always", "auto", "automatic", "never"):
+            raise _bad_argument("classify", classify)
+        opts.classify = "always" if classify == "always" else ("always" if classify in ("auto", "automatic") and sys.stdout.isatty() else "never")
+
+    absolute = parsed.last_value("absolute")
+    if absolute is not None:
+        mapping = {"on": "on", "yes": "on", "follow": "follow", "off": "off", "no": "off"}
+        if absolute not in mapping:
+            raise _bad_argument("absolute", absolute)
+        opts.absolute = mapping[absolute]
+
+    opts.header = parsed.has("header")
+    opts.permissions = not parsed.has("no-permissions")
+    opts.filesize = not parsed.has("no-filesize")
+    opts.file_flags = parsed.has("flags")
+    if parsed.has("bytes") and (not parsed.has("binary") or parsed.last_flag("binary", "bytes") == "bytes"):
+        opts.size_style = "bytes"
+    elif parsed.has("binary"):
+        opts.size_style = "binary"
+
+    time_word = parsed.last_value("time")
+    selected = []
+    if parsed.has("no-time"):
+        selected = []
+    elif time_word is not None:
+        tmapping = {"mod": "modified", "modified": "modified", "ch": "changed", "changed": "changed", "acc": "accessed", "accessed": "accessed", "cr": "created", "created": "created"}
+        if time_word not in tmapping:
+            raise _bad_argument("time", time_word)
+        selected = [tmapping[time_word]]
+    else:
+        for flag_name in ("modified", "changed", "created", "accessed"):
+            if parsed.has(flag_name):
+                selected.append(flag_name)
+        if not selected:
+            selected = ["modified"]
+    opts.time_fields = selected
+
+    time_style = parsed.last_value("time-style")
+    if time_style is None:
+        time_style = os.environ.get("TIME_STYLE") or "default"
+    if time_style not in ("default", "relative", "iso", "long-iso", "full-iso") and not time_style.startswith("+"):
+        raise _bad_argument("time-style", time_style)
+    opts.time_style = time_style
+    opts.stdin = parsed.has("stdin") or not sys.stdin.isatty()
+    return opts

+FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY = 0x00000001
+FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN = 0x00000002
+FILE_ATTRIBUTE_SYSTEM = 0x00000004
+FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY = 0x00000010
+FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE = 0x00000020
+FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT = 0x00000400
+
+
+def _path_name(path: str) -> str:
+    normalized = ntpath.normpath(path)
+    name = ntpath.basename(normalized)
+    if name:
+        return name
+    if path in (".", ".."):
+        return path
+    drive, tail = ntpath.splitdrive(normalized)
+    return tail or drive or path

+@dataclass
+class FileInfo:
+    path: str
+    name: str
+    parented: bool = False
+    is_all_all: bool = False
+    _lstat: Optional[os.stat_result] = None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def argument(cls, path: str) -> "FileInfo":
+        return cls(path=path, name=_path_name(path))
+
+    @classmethod
+    def child(cls, directory: str, name: str, st: Optional[os.stat_result] = None) -> "FileInfo":
+        return cls(path=ntpath.join(directory, name), name=name, parented=True, _lstat=st)
+
+    def lstat(self) -> os.stat_result:
+        if self._lstat is None:
+            self._lstat = os.lstat(self.path)
+        return self._lstat
+
+    def followed_stat(self) -> os.stat_result:
+        return os.stat(self.path)
+
+    def attrs(self) -> int:
+        st = self.lstat()
+        attrs = getattr(st, "st_file_attributes", 0)
+        if attrs:
+            return int(attrs)
+        result = 0
+        if _stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode):
+            result |= FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY
+        elif _stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
+            result |= FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE
+        if not os.access(self.path, os.W_OK):
+            result |= FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY
+        if self.is_link():
+            result |= FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT
+        return result
+
+    def is_link(self) -> bool:
+        return _stat.S_ISLNK(self.lstat().st_mode) or bool(self.attrs() & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT and os.path.islink(self.path))
+
+    def is_dir(self) -> bool:
+        return _stat.S_ISDIR(self.lstat().st_mode) and not self.is_link()
+
+    def is_file(self) -> bool:
+        return _stat.S_ISREG(self.lstat().st_mode) and not self.is_link()
+
+    def points_to_dir(self) -> bool:
+        if self.is_dir():
+            return True
+        if self.is_link():
+            try:
+                return os.path.isdir(self.path)
+            except OSError:
+                return False
+        return False
+
+    def length(self) -> int:
+        return int(self.lstat().st_size)
+
+    def extension(self) -> Optional[str]:
+        pos = self.name.rfind(".")
+        return None if pos < 0 else self.name[pos + 1 :].lower()
+
+    def time_ns(self, which: str, deref: bool = False) -> Optional[int]:
+        try:
+            st = self.followed_stat() if deref and self.is_link() else self.lstat()
+        except OSError:
+            return None
+        if which in ("modified", "changed"):
+            return int(st.st_mtime_ns)
+        if which == "accessed":
+            return int(st.st_atime_ns)
+        birth_ns = getattr(st, "st_birthtime_ns", None)
+        return int(birth_ns if birth_ns is not None else st.st_ctime_ns)
+

+_NATURAL_PARTS = re.compile(r"(\d+)")
+
+
+def _natural_chunks(value: str, insensitive: bool) -> list[tuple[int, object, object]]:
+    if insensitive:
+        value = value.lower()
+    chunks: list[tuple[int, object, object]] = []
+    for part in _NATURAL_PARTS.split(value):
+        if not part:
+            continue
+        if part.isdigit():
+            significant = part.lstrip("0") or "0"
+            chunks.append((0, len(significant), significant))
+        else:
+            chunks.append((1, part, ""))
+    return chunks
+

+def _compare_values(a, b) -> int:
+    return (a > b) - (a < b)
+
+
+def _natural_compare(a: str, b: str, insensitive: bool) -> int:
+    ac = _natural_chunks(a, insensitive)
+    bc = _natural_chunks(b, insensitive)
+    for left, right in zip(ac, bc):
+        result = _compare_values(left, right)
+        if result:
+            return result
+    return _compare_values(len(ac), len(bc))
+

+def compare_files(a: FileInfo, b: FileInfo, opts: Options) -> int:
+    field_name = opts.sort
+    if field_name == "none":
+        return 0
+    if field_name in ("name", "Name", ".name", ".Name"):
+        an = a.name[1:] if field_name.startswith(".") and a.name.startswith(".") else a.name
+        bn = b.name[1:] if field_name.startswith(".") and b.name.startswith(".") else b.name
+        return _natural_compare(an, bn, field_name in ("name", ".name"))
+    if field_name in ("extension", "Extension"):
+        ae, be = a.extension(), b.extension()
+        if ae is None or be is None:
+            result = _compare_values(ae is not None, be is not None)
+        else:
+            result = _compare_values(ae, be)
+        if result:
+            return result
+        return _natural_compare(a.name, b.name, field_name == "extension")
+    if field_name == "size":
+        return _compare_values(a.length(), b.length())
+    if field_name in ("modified", "changed", "accessed", "created", "age"):
+        left = a.time_ns(field_name if field_name != "age" else "modified", opts.deref)
+        right = b.time_ns(field_name if field_name != "age" else "modified", opts.deref)
+        lk = (-1 if left is None else left)
+        rk = (-1 if right is None else right)
+        result = _compare_values(lk, rk)
+        return -result if field_name == "age" else result
+    if field_name == "type":
+        def rank(f: FileInfo) -> int:
+            if f.is_dir(): return 0
+            if f.is_file(): return 1
+            return 7
+        result = _compare_values(rank(a), rank(b))
+        return result or _natural_compare(a.name, b.name, False)
+    return 0
+

+def sort_files(files: list[FileInfo], opts: Options) -> list[FileInfo]:
+    files.sort(key=functools.cmp_to_key(lambda a, b: compare_files(a, b, opts)))
+    if opts.reverse:
+        files.reverse()
+    if opts.dirs_first:
+        files.sort(key=lambda f: not f.points_to_dir())
+    elif opts.dirs_last:
+        files.sort(key=lambda f: f.points_to_dir())
+    return files
+

+def _ignored(name: str, patterns: Iterable[str]) -> bool:
+    return any(fnmatch.fnmatchcase(name, pattern) for pattern in patterns)
+
+
+def filter_children(files: list[FileInfo], opts: Options, is_recurse: bool) -> list[FileInfo]:
+    result = [f for f in files if not _ignored(f.name, opts.ignore_patterns)]
+    filtered: list[FileInfo] = []
+    for f in result:
+        keep = True
+        if opts.only_dirs and not opts.only_files:
+            keep = f.is_dir() or (opts.show_symlinks and f.points_to_dir())
+        elif opts.only_files and not opts.only_dirs:
+            if is_recurse:
+                keep = True
+            elif opts.show_symlinks:
+                keep = f.is_file() or (f.is_link() and not f.points_to_dir())
+            else:
+                keep = f.is_file()
+        elif opts.no_symlinks and not opts.show_symlinks:
+            keep = not f.is_link()
+        if keep:
+            filtered.append(f)
+    return filtered
+

+def read_children(directory: FileInfo, opts: Options) -> list[FileInfo]:
+    children: list[FileInfo] = []
+    if opts.dot_mode == 2:
+        current = FileInfo(directory.path, ".", True, True)
+        parent = FileInfo(ntpath.join(directory.path, ".."), "..", True, True)
+        children.extend((current, parent))
+    with os.scandir(directory.path) as entries:
+        for entry in entries:
+            name = entry.name
+            try:
+                st = entry.stat(follow_symlinks=False)
+            except OSError:
+                st = None
+            child = FileInfo.child(directory.path, name, st)
+            if opts.dot_mode == 0:
+                if name.startswith(".") or name.startswith("_"):
+                    continue
+                try:
+                    if child.attrs() & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN:
+                        continue
+                except OSError:
+                    pass
+            children.append(child)
+    return children

+def _escape_control(text: str) -> str:
+    pieces = []
+    mapping = {"\t": "\\t", "\r": "\\r", "\n": "\\n", "\0": "\\0", "\\": "\\\\", "'": "\\'", '"': '\\"'}
+    for char in text:
+        code = ord(char)
+        if code >= 0x20 and code != 0x7F:
+            pieces.append(char)
+        elif char in mapping:
+            pieces.append(mapping[char])
+        else:
+            pieces.append(f"\\u{{{code:x}}}")
+    return "".join(pieces)
+
+
+def escape_name(text: str, quote: bool) -> str:
+    escaped = _escape_control(text)
+    needs_quotes = " " in text or "'" in text
+    if quote and needs_quotes:
+        mark = '"' if "'" in text else "'"
+        return mark + escaped + mark
+    return escaped
+

+def _normal_display_path(path: str) -> str:
+    return ntpath.normpath(path)
+
+
+def display_base_name(file: FileInfo, opts: Options) -> str:
+    if opts.absolute == "on":
+        raw = ntpath.abspath(file.path)
+        return escape_name(_normal_display_path(raw), opts.quote)
+    if opts.absolute == "follow":
+        try:
+            raw = os.path.realpath(file.path)
+        except OSError:
+            raw = ntpath.abspath(file.path)
+        return escape_name(_normal_display_path(raw), opts.quote)
+    prefix = ""
+    if not file.parented:
+        parent = ntpath.dirname(_normal_display_path(file.path))
+        if parent:
+            prefix = escape_name(parent, opts.quote) + "\\"
+    return prefix + escape_name(file.name, opts.quote)
+
+
+def _classify(file: FileInfo, opts: Options) -> str:
+    if opts.classify != "always":
+        return ""
+    if file.is_dir():
+        return "/"
+    if file.is_link():
+        return "@"
+    return ""
+
+
+def _link_target_text(file: FileInfo, opts: Options) -> Optional[str]:
+    if not file.is_link() or opts.deref:
+        return None
+    try:
+        target_path = os.readlink(file.path)
+    except OSError:
+        return None
+    if target_path.startswith("\\\\?\\"):
+        target_path = target_path[4:]
+    target_exists = os.path.exists(file.path)
+    if not target_exists:
+        return escape_name(target_path, opts.quote)
+    parent = ntpath.dirname(_normal_display_path(target_path))
+    name = _path_name(target_path)
+    shown = (escape_name(parent, opts.quote) + "\\" if parent else "") + escape_name(name, opts.quote)
+    try:
+        target_info = FileInfo(target_path if ntpath.isabs(target_path) else ntpath.join(ntpath.dirname(file.path), target_path), name)
+        shown += _classify(target_info, opts)
+    except OSError:
+        pass
+    return shown
+
+
+def display_name(file: FileInfo, opts: Options, show_link: bool = True) -> str:
+    result = display_base_name(file, opts)
+    target = _link_target_text(file, opts) if show_link else None
+    if target is not None:
+        result += " -> " + target
+    else:
+        result += _classify(file, opts)
+    if opts.hyperlink:
+        try:
+            absolute = os.path.realpath(file.path)
+            uri_path = absolute.replace(" ", "%20")
+            result = f"\x1b]8;;file://{uri_path}\x1b\\{result}\x1b]8;;\x1b\\"
+        except OSError:
+            pass
+    return result

+def _grid_render(cells: list[str], width: int, across: bool, spacing: int = 2) -> str:
+    if not cells:

+    best_col_widths = [max(widths)]

+        for index, cell_width in enumerate(widths):
